title: Undercraft
description: Undercraft adds Undertale items and armors into Minecraft, with accurate mechanics!
body:
# Undercraft
![All items in the mod.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6034d22bfae493194e398e63c5d268be9b6a714f.png)
Undercraft is a mod that adds every single weapon and armor from Undertale into Minecraft, with a new menu (press I) and (mostly) Undertale-accurate FIGHT mechanics!

# Weapons
All of your favorite Undertale weapons are in Minecraft! To FIGHT just like Undertale, all you need to do is get any weapon from the mod, hit a mob with it, and then you'll see a bar at the top of the screen! Press Z with the right timing just like Undertale to do some damage.

# Armors
All of your favorite Undertale armors are here too (except Temmie Armor)!

# Stats Menu (I)
The Stats Menu is a new menu, laid out just like Undertale (with some bonus parts too)!!
